opportunities.title: Conference Attendance Award

amount.raw: The Conference Attendance Award will cover registration for the conference(s) applied for and attendance at the meeting dinner(s) as detailed above. The member can apply to attend up to three meetings with one application. The recipient will then receive a contribution toward advanced standard travel and accommodation, up to the total value of the award, on presentation of receipts for costs incurred.

opportunities.summary: To support member engagement at Society meetings and Society-sponsored events.

opportunities.title: Education and Teaching Award

amount.raw: To support members wishing to develop new educational resources or conduct a piece of publishable educational research that addresses a key question in physiological education.

opportunities.summary: To support the development of new educational resources or educational research in physiology.

opportunities.title: Research and Knowledge Exchange Award

amount.raw: To support members wishing to conduct pilot studies, develop a new technique or to finalise a project, as well as supporting activities to promote knowledge transfer and impact.

opportunities.summary: To support pilot studies, new techniques, and knowledge transfer activities in physiology.

opportunities.title: Institutional Engagement Award

amount.raw: Provides funding to support Society Representatives and members to host events at their organisation, including internal conferences, teaching symposia, seminars or outreach events.

opportunities.summary: To support hosting of events at institutions to promote physiology.

opportunities.title: The Paton Historical Studies Fund

amount.raw: An opportunity for Members to discover more about the history of physiology. We are offering small grants to promote research or engagement activities in the history of modern physiology.

opportunities.summary: To support research or engagement activities in the history of modern physiology.

opportunities.title: Unlocking Futures Fund

amount.raw: Our Unlocking Futures Fund is open to postdoctoral researchers who require an additional support to help them achieve their full potential.

opportunities.summary: To support postdoctoral researchers in achieving their full potential.

opportunities.title: Equity, Diversity and Inclusion Fund

amount.raw: The Society is committed to the principles of Equity, Diversity, and Inclusion and to creating a community and culture in which they are embedded across all activities.

opportunities.summary: To support activities that address equity, diversity, and inclusion in physiology.
